properties.value: Review patient chart for all eligibility criteria
Check, initial and date all eligibility criteria met
Inform treating physician of pending eligibility
There is no fixed schedule for this.

• Attend patient appt with a copy of the informed consent for patient review
  • PI or Sub-I to inform patient of the availability of clinical trial and treatment logistics
  • Clinical research staff to explain in detail specifics of patient participation in clinical trial (i.e., why they are being asked to participate, who is overseeing/funding the study, what is being researched/answered from data, what tasks will the patient need to complete, how will the patient be billed for visits/treatment, patient’s right to withdraw and HIPAA)
  • Encourage patient to ask questions and reiterate information back to ensure patient understands
  • If patient is unsure if they want to participate at the time of the visit, allow patient to take a copy of the consent home to review
    • Provide business card and encourage the patient to follow-up with questions/determination within a few days
    • Follow-up with the patient if they do not reach out with a final decision
  • Obtain patient signature and physician signature on informed consent form
    • Ensure all optional specimen collections are answered yes or no
    • Obtain witness signature if applicable (can be a family member or clinic staff, no research team member can sign as a witness)
  • Once all signatures are obtained, provide patient with a copy of the signed consent form for their records
  • Inform patient of any upcoming appts or research tasks needed to move forward with registration/randomization
